What I can do on your WordPress site.

Full site builds

Up to 8 responsive pages in Elementor or Gutenberg, with on-page SEO, schema basics and llms.txt, built on staging and launched with a QA checklist.

Custom pages and layouts

Elementor pages, responsive layouts, navigation, forms and call-to-action buttons, styled to stay consistent with the rest of the site.

Plugins and integrations

Google Reviews, Tutor LMS and Calendly calls to action, set up and troubleshot on real client sites.

Fixes and mobile navigation

Broken links, mobile navigation and general website updates, reviewed in staging before changes go live.

Technical SEO and tracking

Schema markup, Rich Results validation, internal linking, and GA4 + GTM setup with key events.

// faq.md

Questions, answered.

Do you work with agencies?

Yes. I can work under your agency's brand, follow your process and tools, and stay behind the scenes.

How long does a project take?

Small fixes usually take 1–3 days. A full website or Shopify store usually takes 2–4 weeks. The timeline is agreed up front, before work starts.

How many revisions are included?

Each package includes 2 rounds of revisions. Small changes after launch are covered by the monthly care plan.

Is my live site safe while you work?

Yes. I work on staging or a duplicate page first, back up with Git, and confirm with you before anything changes on the live site.
